extraction_notes: Extracted SI performance data only. Literature-comparison rows in SI Tables S1 and S2 that are not marked 'This work' were excluded. DFT/characterisation figures and tables were excluded. SI Figure S5 is an Arrhenius plot of ln(rate) rather than directly reported rates and was not converted into rates. SI Figures S6, S13, S16 and related isotope/TPR/kinetic plots were not extracted as ammonia synthesis performance records with direct rate/outlet NH3/TOF values.
